detail:
Just finished: "just did". Also "nothing but".

- `V-た + ばかり` = just did
- `N + ばかり` = nothing but

> Example: 食べたばかり = just ate

Passive voice: "be done to".

> Example: 先生に褒められた = I was praised by the teacher

Causative: "make/let someone do".

> Example: 子供に野菜を食べさせる = Make the child eat vegetables

Completion with regret or unintentionally: "ended up doing".

> Example: 食べてしまった = I ate it all (with regret)

Make an effort: "try to do / make sure to do".

> Example: 毎日運動するようにしています

Towards/against: expresses direction of feeling or action.

> Example: その決定に対して反対です

From the perspective of: "for / to".

> Example: 私にとって家族が一番大切です
